en: Now, let's settle this once and\nfor all.

I'm not the same as I was last
year, Ms. Evelysse! Can you
still say that after seeing this
form!!
Ugh...! No matter what form\nyou take, I won't lose!!
Hehehe... I wonder how long\nthat bravado will last.
Now, let the battle begin...!
*Sigh*... What on earth is this\nperformance?

Apparently, it's a hanetsuki match
between Evelysse and Coro. They
couldn't settle it last year, so they're
determined to do it this year...
Hanetsuki, huh... For that, Coro\nseems to be wearing some\nrather extreme gear.
Um, it's called the "Ultimate\nHanetsuki Weapon:\n<font color=yellow>Lucky-Bringing Darmizer '56</font>."

According to the instruction manual, it
has a body made of special alloys with
barriers created by Symbol Arts, and
by linking Coro's AI to it...

I don't really get it, but I can
tell that it's definitely not
equipment meant for playing
hanetsuki,

and that Evelysse's physical
abilities are completely insane
for being able to keep up with
it.
So, Captain. I take it you're the\nwitness for this duel of the\ncentury.
There's no need to use a word\nas ominous as "duel."

Getting some moderate
exercise during the New Year,
when it's easy to just eat and
sleep... isn't that a good thing?
I'll settle it right here!\nHaaaaaaaaaaaa!!
This is nothing! Try this!!
I think you're just as delusional\nfor calling this carnage\n"moderate exercise."

Still, what a lovely place. I can't
believe there's such an open
area at the peak of a mountain
range.

It's a great spot for a vacation. I don't
dislike the sea of stars, but I still prefer
to spend my leisure time with my feet
on the ground.

Just to be safe, I've hidden the ship
with the cloaking device, and since
there are steep mountains all around, it
should only be visible from above.

Besides, the civilization level of this
planet is roughly equivalent to Earth's
Middle Ages, so there's no way we'll be
discovered...
Hmph, I wonder about that.
Huh?
I... I can't believe it...
Hm? Is that a local?
No way, did they actually climb\nthese steep mountains?!
Over here! They're over here!\nNo... they are right here!!
Oh, how divine... You must be\nthe party of goddesses the\n<font color=yellow>Kannagi</font> spoke of!
Wait, what is going on?!
This is bad. Coro, hide us! Now!\nAnd contact the others who\nare resting!
Y-yeeessss!!!

Oh! As expected of a warrior
serving the goddesses! With a
single shout, you have
exorcised that evil presence!
Huh? No...

Grandpa, we can talk about
that later! Come on, everyone,
stop dawdling! The Kannagi
told us!

The beautiful goddesses of war are
exhausted from their battle against evil.
We must hurry and invite them to our
feast to restore their strength!
Yeah!!
Please, Goddesses. We have\nprepared palanquins for you.\nPlease, step inside!
Wait, what is actually going on\nhere!?
What should we do, Captain! At\nthis rate, they're really going to\ncarry us away!
Are you saying we should just\ngo along with them... Is that\nreally okay!?

Look at the desperation on these
people's faces. There must be a reason
for this. As the Captain said, let's at
least hear them out.
Eleyna, can you see something\nwe can't?

Who knows. Come on, let's go.
Celebrating the New Year with
some local sake doesn't sound
too bad.
The priestess spoke of the\nfirst day of the Month of\nHarmony.

Upon the peaks of the
mountains in the East, three
stars descended alongside the
rising sun.
These three stars were divine\nmaidens sent to battle the evil\ndemons plaguing the land.
Drawing strength from the\nhealing feasts offered by the\npeople,
The princesses shall slay the\ndemons and restore a pure\nbreeze to this land.

First a food shortage due to
crop failure, and now a plague...
This country seems to be in
quite a state of chaos.

And then there's us, just happening to
be at the exact spot predicted by that
famous fortune teller... the "Kannagi,"
was it?

The people here seem absolutely
convinced that simply hosting us will be
enough to save them from their current
plight...

Situation analysis complete! It
appears the widespread crop
failure in this region is due to
climate change.	machine
C129_020_10	762dfae8160b40f9fd2786b89d4c826fde99e74f	As for the plague, it is a result of
malnutrition caused by the food
shortage; I found no evidence of
advanced civilizations being involved.

So the people of this land are
facing hardships that are
simply a byproduct of natural
evolution?
That seems to be the case...

Captain, this is a difficult decision, but
intervening to save them would be a
violation of the Uncivilized Planet
Protection Treaty.

Captain, you're saying we're
just going to find a chance to
leave... and abandon the people
of this country!!
Hey, Evelysse, keep your voice\ndown. They'll hear you.
But...

...That is the law of nature. If we
intervene and force an unnatural
evolution upon them, it could lead to an
even worse situation.

All we can do is leave quietly
and pray that they overcome
this hardship through their own
strength.

Helping people in an
underdeveloped civilization
without caution could warp
their path of evolution...
Baschen might have been in a\nstate like that after Givel\nappeared...
He left everything to Givel and\nstopped thinking for himself,\nand as a result, he was used.
What is the matter,\nGoddesses! Such gloomy faces\nwill bring us bad luck!
This meal is humble and may\nnot be to your liking, but\nplease, help yourselves.

Was that the elder and his
granddaughter? I don't see any
food for you two; aren't you
eating?

It would be far too bold for us
to share a meal with the
Goddesses... please, do not
mind us...
Is something bothering you?
Ah, no... it is but a trivial\nmatter, but...

We were told that three Goddesses
would descend. We were simply
wondering why things are differing from
the Oracle's prophecy...
Indeed, the Oracle's prophecies\nhave never been wrong until\nnow.
...Three Goddesses, huh.
What's with that look, Crowe? I\nam a perfectly fine Goddess\nmyself.

The old man is just a bit of a
worrywart! Please don't let it bother
you, Goddesses! Now, let us show you
one of the finest dancers in the land!

*Sigh*, the country is in such a dire
state, yet they're throwing a party
based on a prophecy... I guess that's
what faith is all about.
Reimi, are you taking a break\nhere too?
Oh, Karlyn.

...I just can't help but wonder if
it's okay for the people of this
country to be doing this while
things are so bad.
Even if we pray, it's not like we\ncan actually do anything to\nhelp them...
It seems we're thinking the\nsame thing.
Goddess, may I have a moment\nof your time?
Oh! Who are you?

I am a servant of the Oracle,
and my name is <font color=yellow>Yamato</font>. The
Oracle wishes to meet with the
Goddess.
The Oracle... the one who\nprophesied our arrival.
Finally arrived, have you?
Hm? And who might you be?
Things will go much smoother if\nI'm present for the discussion\nwith this Oracle. I'll come along.
Eleyna, what do you mean? If\nyou know something...
The Oracle will explain the\nsituation. Now, let's go.
Very well. Please, follow me.
This way, please. Please watch\nyour step, as it is quite dark.
What is this place? I can't\nbelieve there was something\nlike this beyond the cave...!
I wonder if the writing on the\nwalls is the language of the\npeople of this land?

Please, do not touch them.
Your powerful energy might
weaken the power of the
"Oracle."

It is an honor to meet you. I am
the one who serves as the
shrine maiden of this land, my
name is <font color=yellow>Iyo</font>.

I sincerely apologize for
involving visitors from the Sea
of Stars in the affairs of our
country.
What, the Sea of Stars!? Just\nhow much do you know about\nus!?

I am aware that you are foreigners who
possess an ark that traverses the Sea
of Stars and have come to this land to
rest.
How could you possibly...

Did you not hear this person mention
the "Oracle" just now? Like me, they
possess the power to see through all
of the past and future.

Unfortunately, I am merely a
descendant of such a person. I
do not possess the power to
hear the oracles myself.

All I can do is decipher the
records of the future left upon
these walls by the first shrine
maiden.

So you saw that and... no, you
mean you've known about
us―about this universe―for a
long time?
Yes, that is correct.

However, if the people of this land were
to suddenly learn of this, chaos would
be inevitable. That is why no one is
permitted to enter this shrine except
for the Oracle and their guardians.
I believe we have the gist of it.\nWhy don't we get to the point?
Thank you.

I wish to eradicate the faith in
the Oracle in this land and
incite a rebellion among the
people.

What?! What do you mean?
The country is already in
chaos, right? You want to start
a rebellion on top of that?!

Precisely why. Now is the only time a
rebellion is possible, while the country
is in turmoil and the people's
frustrations are peaking.
...I don't understand. Iyo, what\nexactly are you trying to do?

According to the Oracle's records
written here, this nation will fall in 278
days. It is written that in the ensuing
chaos, 90% of the population will
perish.

90% of the people?! If that
happens, it's only a matter of
time before the survivors die
too...
Yes. That is why I wish to\noverturn this prophecy.

An oracle is but one possible
future. However, overturning it
requires more than ordinary
strength.
Yes, which is why I must cast\naside faith and incite a popular\nuprising.
So that's what was happening\nwhile those three disappeared\nduring yesterday's banquet.
Still, that priestess has some\nserious guts.

Holding a massive feast under her own
orders while the people are starving
from poor harvests, just to draw all the
resentment toward herself.

Then, she'll show the people us
being defeated by the demons
to drive home the fact that the
prophecy was wrong... huh.

True, if the people are this
blindly devoted to the
priestess, the shock of a failed
prophecy would be immense.

Furthermore, it seems the core
members of the rebel army
have already been arranged
under Yamato's direction.

The plan is to have the elite
force Yamato gathered defeat
the demons, turning them into
heroes.

Thorough as always. I guess the idea is
that if there are heroes to lead the
country next, the chaos following the
rebellion will be kept to a minimum.

What was written in that shrine was
likely the future that awaits a people
who cling to oracles and can do nothing
but pray to the gods.

If a great shift occurs in the
people's consciousness, it may
be possible to overturn the
oracle.

But what happens to Iyo? The plan is
to make everyone resent her as the
priestess to spark a rebellion, right? I
can't imagine she'll get out of this
unscathed.

It seems they've already made
preparations for her to flee to another
country, making it look like Yamato
defeated her when the rebellion breaks
out.

This is an internal matter for this
country, and getting involved recklessly
could potentially violate the Uncharted
Planet Protection Treaty.
But I still want to help Iyo.

I believe this is a fight for the people of
this land to break free from the
supernatural power of the oracle and
return to the path of proper evolution.
So, Captain, everyone, please...

I agree with the Captain. I'll
help even if you don't ask. I
can't just abandon lives right in
front of me.
So, what about our "demon"\nwho's always nagging us about\nprotecting uncharted planets?
Of course! If the Captain says\nit's okay, I'm all in! No problem\nat all!

I can use 'Darmizer'56,' whom
everyone in the country
believes to be the incarnation
of evil,

to make it look like I crushed Evelysse
and the others, or to act as if I was
defeated by Yamato and his group. It'll
be a piece of cake!
Though I'm not thrilled about\nthe idea of being defeated by\nCoro.
I heard Iyo's words of resolve\nwith my own ears. I have no\nreason to object.

It has been since you stopped
the resurrection of Asmodeus
that I last saw an oracle
overturned. I look forward to it.
Reimi, we are all of one mind.\nWe will fight to seize the\nrightful future of this country!
Thank you, everyone!
Now, let us settle this. In the\nname of the gods, I cannot\noverlook any further folly!
Now, let us fight with honor...!

(Wait, what's wrong, Coro! Did
you forget your lines!?
Everyone is watching, get it
together!!)
(Ugh, hey!! This isn't what we\ndiscussed!)
(Karlyn! Everyone is watching!\nFor now, let's just keep\nfighting!!)
Gah!!
Karlyn, are you okay!? Coro,\nwait! You've gone way too far!!
Everyone!! This is an\nemergency!! Please evacuate\nimmediately!!
Finally, the comms are working!\nListen, you need to learn some\nrestraint...!!
That's not it, Evelysse! That's\nnot me! It's moving on its own\nwithout being linked to my AI!!
What? That outer shell is\nmoving by itself!?

It seems so. I'm searching for the cause
now, but there's a special barrier
preventing me from accessing the
control mechanism...
Can you see something,\nEleyna!?
No, I can't tell...
(But for even me to be unable\nto read it...)
She's right, Captain! Let's\nprioritize the evacuation of the\ncitizens first!

We'll secure the retreat.
Yamato, take your unit and
protect everyone gathered
here and get them to safety!
I cannot retreat.

Don't be stubborn! We don't
even understand the situation
ourselves! First, you all need to
get to a safe place...

If we retreat under your protection, my
people will never be able to break free
from their faith in the gods and the
miko!
But with your equipment, trying\nto fight that weapon is...
Nevertheless, this is a battle\nfor our very future!
Everyone, follow me!!
Dammit...! We can't just leave it\nto them! Captain, let's fight!
Hyaaaaah!

The enemy flinched! As
expected of an elite unit. Their
training and morale are higher
than I imagined.

But with so few of us, we can
only hold out for so long!
Captain, I'll go command the
evacuation in the rear.
Guh... is this... the end...?

Stand up! Do not falter!! Raise
your heads and stare down the
enemy! Our future lies only
there!
...!! Damn it... I can't let us lose\nhere...! Raaaaaaagh!!
Everyone, hurry down the\nmountain! I'll lead the way, so\nplease follow my instructions!

...Why? Why are those people
fighting? The Priestess's
prophecy said the Goddess
would slay the demons for us.

If we just follow the Priestess
without question, everything
will work out... Why are those
people doing this...!?
Elder, do you honestly believe\nthis situation will resolve itself\nif you do nothing?
...G-Goddess. I... I...

Regardless, it's dangerous
here! Prioritize the wounded
and the children during the
evacuation!
Goddess! I'll go gather\neveryone who can use healing\narts!
Please do!
You! What on earth are you\ndoing?!

I'm going to lend Yamato a hand! With
the crops failing, I've barely used a hoe
lately―I was starting to feel like I was
getting rusty!

I appreciate it, but know when
to retreat! Please, don't let
your courage turn into
recklessness!

What are you thinking! Do you
not believe in the Goddess's
victory!? Do you dare doubt
the Miko's prophecy!?

Elder, this isn't a matter of
belief. When your comrades are
fighting right in front of you,
it's only natural to lend a hand.
Now, I will go and guide\neveryone to safety.
I'm going too! Gramps, you go\nhelp the Goddess! Everyone will\nlisten to you.
What, reinforcements!?\nYamato, were you still\npreparing troops?
N-no... But those faces... they're military\nofficers and officials from the Central\nCouncil... What on earth is happening?
There are dozens of times\nmore people here than an elite\nsquad. At this rate...!
Yes, let's settle this in one go!
Did it stop...?

I've gained access to
Darmizer'56's control
mechanism! It won't go on
rampaging now!
We did it... We actually pulled it\noff...
WE WONNNNN!!!!
Thank goodness. For a moment\nthere, I wasn't sure how things\nwould turn out...

Thanks to everyone's
cooperation, it looks like no
one suffered any serious
injuries. Thank you all so much!
Oh, to receive such words from\nthe Goddess... I am humbled.

If anything, we were only able to fight
because of the Goddess!! Seeing her
bravery boosts our morale! A true
Goddess of War!
I'm sorry for deceiving you all\nuntil now. We aren't gods or\nanything like that...
We are humans, just like you.
Huh...?

We were born in a place far from here,
and our ancestors faced and overcame
disasters many times, just like the ones
you are facing now.

So, we are just humans who
happen to know a few more
tricks and a bit more wisdom
for survival than you do.

In fact, I lived deep underground
because the surface had become a
polluted wasteland where people could
no longer survive.
...C-could such a thing actually\nhappen?
Unfortunately, yes.

But that was the result of my parents
and many others thinking desperately
to pass a glimmer of hope on to the
future.

There are depths of despair that make
you want to cling to a god. ...But that
should only happen after you've done
your absolute best.
The gods don't smile upon\nthose who do nothing.

The cause of the faith that led
our people to cling to the gods
lies with us, the clan of the
Miko.
Lady Ichiyo! You were here!?\nWhat is the meaning of this...!

First, to the travelers from afar, and to
everyone gathered here: I thank you
from the bottom of my heart for saving
our nation from its plight.
And now... please, listen.
...!! Ichiyo, you aren't planning to\ntalk about the prophecy here,\nare you!?
Lady Iyo! You mustn't!!
Yamato, stand back. I will tell\nthem everything... including the\nsins of our shrine maidens.

...M-My Lady. Then what were the
prophecies all this time...? I thought you
were always guiding us on the
righteous path...!!

By reading the prophecies left
by the first shrine maiden, one
can predict the future to a
certain extent.

However, since the descriptions are not
detailed, some shrine maidens have
passed them off as prophecies to lead
the people. I am no exception.
...How can this be! Are you\nsaying you shrine maidens\nhave been deceiving us?!
I don't think that's right.

I got a look inside the shrine, and there
were piles of documents―domestic
affairs, annual crop yields, the
movements of neighboring countries,
new technologies...

I believe the successive shrine maidens
used those documents to seek the
best possible path, and then guided the
country by presenting those findings as
prophecies.
They bore that heavy burden\nalone, unable to tell anyone...

We just wanted to take the
easy way out by leaving
everything to the shrine
maiden...

I'm sorry. We didn't know any
of that; we just thought we
should put all our faith in the
shrine maiden...
It is not all your fault.
Hmm?

The successive priestesses underestimated the
strength of the people. They were so desperate
to handle everything themselves that they
refused to rely on anyone. Iyo, you are the
same, aren't you?

Have you seen the people of
this land fight with Dauntless
Courage? They are far more
reliable than you think.

...You are right. It seems it was
my own way of thinking, rather
than the country, that needed
to change.

Then please, count on us from now on,
Priestess! If we all work together, I'm
sure we can do something about the
poor harvests and the plague!
...But, the clan of priestesses\nhas continued to deceive you\nall for decades...!

...It must have been painful to
lie just to protect us. From
now on, we won't just rely on
you; we will walk beside you.
Iyo, there is no one here who\nwants to condemn you.

Besides, you've gone through all those
piles of documents, right? Your
knowledge is necessary for the future
of this country.

...I haven't lived this long for
nothing. I have some knowledge
of farming methods. I shall call
upon the other elders as well.
Elder...! Thank you so much.

I suppose this is exactly what
they call a new beginning for
this country. It's a perfect fit
for this scenery!

This story has come to an end.
More stories are planned for
release in the future. Please
look forward to them.

The issues with food and plague won't
be resolved overnight, but meetings to
find a solution are progressing. It is all
thanks to everyone.

No, it was the hard work of the
elite squad that moved
people's hearts. We didn't
really...
You looked the part, leading\nthat elite squad, Yamato.
In that case, I am even more\ngrateful to the two of you.

If it weren't for Reimi's words back
then, I think I would still be agonizing
over it and would never have been able
to lead the squad like that...
The day before the final battle

Yamato, this elite squad you summoned
is quite a force. They're disciplined and
their morale is high. Are they your
subordinates?
No, they are comrades from\nwhen I was assigned to guard\nthe northern border.

I heard from Iyo that this country is
under invasion from a neighboring
nation. That's why everyone is so
accustomed to combat, isn't it?

Yes. Furthermore, everyone is
risking everything on the hope
that this battle will change this
country.
Risking everything?

The border regions originally received
little aid from the capital and were
poor, but this recent crop failure has
pushed them into the worst possible
situation.

If this war changes the country, there
is a chance they can save their families
who suffer from disease and hunger.
That is why morale is so high.
Yamato, what about you?
...It's a lie, isn't it? That there's\na country willing to shelter Iyo\nif a rebellion breaks out.

She intends to end this
rebellion through her own
execution to build a new
nation.
...My apologies. The Miko\nforbade me from speaking of it,\nfearing it would worry you all.

Yamato, are you really okay
with this? A reform built upon
the sacrifice of someone who
loves her country that much!
...It is not a matter of whether I\nam okay with it or not...

The Miko has decided. As her
guardian, I will carry out my
duty with every ounce of my
strength until the end.
I can tell just by watching you\ndraw your bow. I can see the\nhesitation in your heart...

Even if this is all a play, you're the one
leading the troops into battle. If the
commander is in that state, won't it
cause problems for everyone?
If there is something going on,\ncould you please tell us about\nit?
...You are truly honest people.\nIt seems I cannot deceive you.
...The truth is, there was once\na time when I tried to kidnap\nthe Miko and run away.
That was about ten years ago,\nwhen the Miko was still in her\nteens.
The country was in chaos, with\ncrop failures continuing across\nthe land, just as they are now.
She must have been working\nwithout sleep or rest,\nsearching for a solution,
for the Miko looked terrible.\nDesperate to get her to drink\nsome medicinal tea,
I broke the taboo and stepped\ninside the Miko's shrine.
And there, I discovered what\nlay within the shrine―the truth\nabout the Miko...

I repeatedly urged her to make it
public, believing it was not a
responsibility a teenage girl should
have to bear, but she never agreed.
Then, the incident occurred.

Driven to desperation by the food
shortage that showed no sign of
improving, young people from the
frontier stormed the Central Council.
Fires broke out all across the\ntown.
As I protected her and fled\nthrough the chaos, I realized\nthat this was an opportunity.
Taking advantage of the\nconfusion, I stole a horse and\nled her away.

I told her, "Let us abandon a
country that burdens you with
such a heavy responsibility,
and live our lives together."
As we rode, we spoke of what\nshe wished to do once we had\nleft the country...
While I was resting the horse,\nshe had vanished.
So Iyo had already resolved\nher path in life, even at that\nage.
From that moment on, I\ndecided to align myself with\nher resolve.

I am the blade that carries out
her wishes. Until the moment
she desires death, I shall grant
it.
And you're just going to leave\neverything up to Iyo-san like\nthat?

If you just give up because you can't
change her mind and stop thinking for
yourself, aren't you just like everyone
else in the country?
...Yamato. Could you tell me\nwhat you're really thinking?
...I want to protect Lady Iyo...!!\nBut if I do, this country she\nloves so dearly will...!
Then it's settled. Let's protect\nthem both. Lady Iyo and this\ncountry!

Even if people call it reckless,
as long as you have an
unwavering resolve within you,
a way will open. I'll help you!

To think that I, too, had
become someone who would
place such a heavy burden on
the Miko... I am truly ashamed.

I'm sure there's a way to protect both
the future of this country and Lady Iyo.
As long as we don't forget to search
for that path together...
Yes. I will keep that in mind\nand continue to devote myself\nto the cause.
Protecting everything, huh...\nReimi, you're starting to sound\na lot like Edge.
What!?
I guess it's true that couples\nstart to resemble each other.\nOnii-san is so happy!
Hmph, couples... what are you\ntalking about, Crowe!! It's not\nlike that at all!!
So you have someone precious\nto you as well, Reimi. I would\nvery much like to meet them.

Want me to call him? If I tell
him Reimi's calling, he'll
probably come running. Hey,
Coro! Can you hear me?
Stop it, Crowe! I told you to\nstop!!

So the prophecy to "hold a
feast to welcome the gods"
was also intended to gather
crops in the center.

Yes. That way, they can buy crops
from regions where they are relatively
plentiful and sell them at a low price to
regions suffering from poor harvests.
The Miko are well-versed in\neconomics as well, it seems.
It is all thanks to the\ndocuments left behind by the\nprevious Miko.

It's not as if everything is perfectly
solved, but it doesn't look like our help
is needed anymore. Shall we get back
to our own journey?
What's wrong?

There's still something
bothering me. I want to know
what on earth was controlling
those Korodaruma.
Maybe Coro just had some\npoor maintenance?

It's possible, but we're talking
about a special barrier being
cast. That alone doesn't
explain it.

...At that time, I felt something similar
to the power I feel at the Miko's shrine.
It may have been the power of the first
Miko.

You mean the first Miko worried about
the country's future and made the
Korodaruma go wild just to give the
people a reason to cooperate?

No way, the first Miko lived hundreds of
years ago, right? Even for her, it's a
stretch to think her spells would still be
active...
That is certainly a possibility.

Ichiyo, the First Priestess's prophecy
spoke of three goddesses arriving. In
other words, she likely did not foresee
my coming.
